Biology 2022 Higher Level, deferred sitting: reviewed task ledger, carded for the first time.

Independent visual sweep (2026-11-19), every page rendered and read:
  * LC025ALP038EV (deferredexams/2022; Sections A and B and Answerbook), 40 pages: p1 cover, p2
    instructions, p3-p9 Section A Questions 1-7, p10-p12 Section B Questions 8-10, p13 Section C
    answerbook instructions, p14-p15 graph paper, p16-p39 ruled answer pages, p40 back cover with the
    copyright notice.
  * LC025ALP040EV (Section C), 12 pages: p1 cover, p2-p10 Questions 11-17, p11 "Do not hand this
    question paper up", p12 back cover with the copyright notice.
  * LC025ALP000EV (deferredmarkingschemes/2022), 32 pages: p1 cover, p2 the deferred-scheme note, p3
    introduction, p4-p5 marking examples, p6-p28 Questions 1-17, p29-p30 "BLANK PAGE", p31-p32 blank.

The sitting has the June 2022 shape (any four of Section A, any one of B, any three of C). The deferred
scheme sets out every printed ask, so no card needs the "prints no answer" row. Tariffs as the scheme
prints them: Q1 best five of six at 4; Q2-Q5 and Q7 one ladder each, 6(3) + 2; Q6 10(2), two definitions
per pair at 2; Section B parts (a) 6 and (b) 24; Section C parts (9), (27), (24) as the paper prints them;
Q16 and Q17 any two of (a)-(d) at 30. Drawings are carded with criterion rows priced as printed (a
diagram "3", "3, 0" or "6, 3, 0", each label "1"); the Q14(b)(v) pyramid's three criteria carry the
scheme's own drawing as a solution figure. Q7's ticks are read from their positions (Wingdings 2 check
marks); Q5(c), Q5(e) and Q17(d)(vi), whose answers are printed as letters or a figure, are read from
their positions too. Numbered asks under a roman (Q8(b)(ii)1-5, Q10(b)(i)-(iv)1-2, Q11(b)(iv)1-2,
Q12(c)(v)1-3, Q13(b)(iii)1-3, Q16(d)(iii)1-2) are priced separately and carded one each.

q2-rhizopus: Four drawings in sequence, joined by arrows: two hyphae marked + and – grow towards each other, with A pointing to their tips; in the second, B points to the joined region between two parts labelled Suspensor; in the third, a dark spiky body labelled Zygospore lies between them; in the fourth, a stalk rises from the zygospore with a round head. Hyphae is labelled.
q3-male: Diagram of the male reproductive system in side view: D points to a tube that runs up from the scrotum and over the top of the bladder; E points to the oval organ inside the scrotum.
q4-muscle: Diagram of a muscle cell: a long striated cell with a dark nucleus labelled Nucleus and many small oval organelles scattered through it, two of them labelled A.
q5-nucleotide: Diagram of a single DNA nucleotide: a circle labelled X joined to a pentagon labelled Y, which is joined to a shape labelled Nitrogenous base; a dotted line from the base is labelled Z.
q5-table: A two-row table. DNA: A, T, G, C, G, A. mRNA: six empty boxes.
q11-phloem: Diagram of a plant tissue in longitudinal section: P points into a wide tube-shaped cell, Q to a narrow cell with dark nuclei beside it, and R to a cross-wall between two of the wide cells.
q12-ge: Diagram in two dashed boxes. Box A: triangles labelled Enzyme beside a chromosome and beside a ring labelled Structure X; an arrow takes a short bar labelled Gene from the chromosome. Box B: the gene, a ring with a gap, and an arrow to a complete ring labelled Structure X with inserted gene.
q13-breathing: Diagram of the human breathing system with an enlarged inset beside a capillary: A and B point to parts of the throat, C to the tube below them, D and E to parts inside the inset, and F to the curved band below the lungs.
q14-pyramid: The marking scheme’s pyramid of numbers, four stacked bars narrowing upwards: Algae at the base, then Mayflies, Trout and Otter at the top.
q15-leg: Diagram of the bones of a human leg: A points to the upper long bone, X to the knee, and B and C to the two bones of the lower leg, above the foot.
q16-brain: Diagram of the internal structure of the human brain in section: the folded upper part labelled D, the lower stem labelled E, and the small rounded part at the back labelled F.
q16-pollen: Diagram of a pollen grain: a round grain with a spiky outer wall and two dark nuclei inside, labelled Nucleus X and Generative nucleus.
q16-bacterium: Electron microscope photograph of a single rod-shaped bacterial cell.
q17-graph: Graph of rate of photosynthesis against light intensity / CO2 concentration: the curve rises slowly, then steeply, and levels off; an arrow labelled X points to where it levels off.
q17-mitosis: Diagram of a cell during mitosis: four X-shaped chromosomes in the centre, curved segments around them, and fibres radiating from a body at each side; A points to the middle of one chromosome, B to one of the curved segments and C to the fibres at one side.
